title: Apple Watch Ultra 3 Gets Big $250 Discounts Ahead of Black Friday
content:
Amazon and Best Buy today have a big collection of Apple Watch Ultra 3 models on sale, starting at $549.00, down from $799.00. This is a massive $250 discount on the previous-generation device, and it's a match for the all-time low price on these models.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

You'll find both Black and Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 models on sale at this record low price at Best Buy. A similar deal is available on Milanese Loop models as well, priced at $649.00, down from $899.00, and this one is available at both retailers.
